games.name: ME: Biddle's Corner
games.desc:
Motorworks Entertainment presents to you: BIDDLE'S CORNER

In this update:

- Implemented new back-end security features
- Re-instated 30 day account age restriction
- Wiped unused Datastores
- Secured Datastores
- Zero-trust system implemented: Player "Risk" now taken into account upon joining the game. Risk factors: Friends / Following a Banned Player, Player is in a Banned / Blacklisted Group. False bans or kicks may occur.
- Slight performance changes
- Moderation panel front/back-end remade
- Secured / Revised delivery system [Changed base delivery pay to $500]
- Announcement / Warning GUI added
- In-game rules tab
and more!

Explore vast open roads with over 150+ vehicles and areas to explore! Make sure to turn on notifications to stay up to date with updates from the Motorworks Entertainment Team! 

Controls:

Throttle - W / RT
Brake - S / LT
Steering - A + D / Left Thumbstick
Shift Up - E / Y
Shift Down - Q / X

Account age must be over 30 days old to play!

Version 2026-RR-1.1

games.name: [❄️💫RE-RELEASE] Anime Adventures
games.desc:
Master your Magic, wield legendary Sacred Treasures, and awaken your true potential. Whether you protect the kingdom as a Holy Knight or crush it as a high-ranking Demon, your destiny is forged in battle.

⚔️ Battle across Britannia—from the Boar Hat Tavern to the Capital of the Dead.  Conquer the seas, slay Raid Bosses, and dominate in Ranked PvP.  Goddess, Demon, Fairy, or Human—choose your Race and join the Holy War.

👍 Like the game for a new code!

Default Controls:

M1 - Basic Attack 

M2 - Heavy / Air Combo

Q - Dash

F - Block

Z / X / C / V -  Skills

Space - Double Jump / Flight

Left Shift - Sprint

Left Alt - Race Ability

M - Menu / Status
